customer: So I just moved out here to Brevin and I'm still getting settled, but I've got this cargo van on a lease and I was thinking maybe I'd sell it to you instead of turning it back in. Thing is, I looked up my buyout and I have a feeling your offer might come in higher than that, and I honestly have no idea what happens with the extra money. The lease is through Bluewater Leasing if that matters at all.
agent: Welcome to the area, and it does matter! Per our article "If our offer is more than your lease buyout," when our offer is higher than your buyout amount, the difference is called lease equity, and who gets it depends on the leasing company. With Bluewater Leasing, that equity is applied to the car you buy from Northwind rather than paid out to you. If our offer ends up lower than the buyout instead, you'd pay the difference at the appointment, the same as negative equity.
